_readme: Every audio file lives flat in this folder (public/demos/). This file is the
only thing that groups them: a playlist is a name and an ordered list of
tracks, and a track is a title plus the bare filename it points at.
A file may appear in as many playlists as you like — nothing is moved or
copied, the playlist is just an ordering.
playlists[].name          the playlist name, shown on the chip
playlists[].note          optional, one line under the heading
playlists[].tracks[].title  the track name, shown in the list
playlists[].tracks[].note   optional, shown small beside the filename
Any extension the browser can play works — .wav, .mp3, .m4a, .opus, .flac.
Swapping a track from .wav to .mp3 is a one-word edit to its `file`.
This key is ignored by the page; only `playlists` is read.
